coverage: 76 provinces plus Bangkok special administrative area, with districts and subdistricts from the DDPM public government service. Multipart rows dissolve by exact official administrative code; parent geometry is derived from the same local land topology. Bangkok khet/khwaeng retain their correct labels. Registered population is published by NSO/DOPA for 2024, including Thai and non-Thai registered residents; it is not census usually-resident population. Full available geometry remains at close zoom, while district/subdistrict chunks load on demand. Source counts and hierarchy are validated during the build. Local-area verification against a separately retained code register: 7420 code-matched subdistricts, 234 geographic islands, 1 municipal footprint and 3 older subdistrict footprints. 16 current subdistricts lack separate geometry in this boundary source, mainly later Bangkok splits; their borders are not invented. A malformed source district code on Ko Thian is corrected to 2306 from its six-digit source hierarchy.
processing: Full available source resolution retained, cleaned together and rounded to six decimal places. Shared internal edges stored once; unselected coasts have no stroke. Deeper geometry loads only for the selected region. All views use the shared regional renderer, selected-outline index, adaptive detail, lifecycle and three-country cache. Territorial waters are excluded from land fills. Territory context features carry their own destination bounds.
